guest_credentials: Former professional cyclist and cycling coach, expertise in power meter training and coaching evolution

First professional year was 1995, arrived at Tour de France level in 1997

Bike handling skills cannot be measured by data but are critical differentiators between professional cyclists like Peter Sagan and amateur riders
specific_numbers: Arrived at Tour de France level 1997
Used SRM starting in 1994 season with US national team
Three hours fasted riding followed by two hours fueled
